notes.title: HOP TOP - 1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Version 1.0.1 of HOP TOP is now live! 
This version includes minor changes reported over the last few days, such as:


Input Remapping now saves changed configurations
Individual Scores in Campaign Mode now display correctly no matter what initial mode is played 
Hard-Crashes found in Game Over and Stage Start sequences are now fixed
Fixed Spike Object Collision Oversight

We truly thank each and everyone so far for their support to HOP TOP thus far!
